prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: original identity exploration board for Headroom, an English household financial decision product for self-employed adults.
Primary request: create a polished flat graphic brand-design board presenting THREE genuinely different logo concepts in three equal vertical columns. Quiet architectural sophistication, warm paper background #F6F5F0, deep forest ink #173F36, black typography, a little mist green #DDEAE3. Original marks, not a copy of any existing company.
Concept A, caption "01  Clearance": a bold minimal abstract lowercase h with a generous rectangular open space and a detached horizontal lintel above the right shoulder; the negative space literally gives the h headroom. Only 3 to 4 flat geometric strokes. Not a house roof, no arrow.
Concept B, caption "02  Two paths": a continuous paired ribbon that separates into two considered routes, simple flat geometric symbol, distinctive asymmetry; no gradients or infinity symbol.
Concept C, caption "03  Open frame": two offset squared brackets with gently rounded inner corners, creating an open room and an understated H in negative space; less literal, editorial.
Composition: each column has a large symbol at top, lowercase "headroom" wordmark below in a refined humanist sans serif, then a miniature one-color symbol and tiny square app-icon application at bottom. Three thin vertical dividing rules. Top-left heading "HEADROOM / IDENTITY STUDY"; top-right small "DESIGN CONCEPT · 2026". Huge disciplined whitespace and immaculate optical alignment.
Style: professional vector-like flat logo presentation rendered as a raster image, crisp edges, no 3D, no mockup devices, no shadows, no fake client logos, no coins, no sparkles, no rising financial chart.
Text must be exactly the specified short labels, no filler prose. Do not add a slogan.
Wide landscape board, every concept legible.

Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: final raster identity concept on a genuinely transparent background
Input image: the attached exploration board is a STYLE AND SHAPE REFERENCE, not a background to preserve.
Primary request: refine ONLY concept 01 Clearance from the left column into one impeccable standalone horizontal brand lockup. Exact lowercase wordmark "headroom". Use the original simple lowercase h-shaped symbol with deep forest #173F36 vertical left stem and rounded right shoulder, and one detached short horizontal lintel above the shoulder. Make the detached lintel deep forest too, ONE-COLOR mark. The deliberate white/transparent slot between lintel and shoulder is the meaning: room above. 
Composition: symbol on left, generous optical gap, lowercase wordmark on right in refined contemporary humanist sans serif, medium weight. Symbol height slightly taller than wordmark. Center the single lockup in a wide horizontal canvas, ample transparent margin.
Style: flat crisp vector-like silhouette rendered as raster, truly solid one-color #173F36, no texture or gradients. Wordmark and symbol optically balanced.
Constraints: background must be transparent alpha; remove all board captions, dividers, secondary concepts and app tiles. No decorative image/background, no shadow, no badge, no slogan, no extra labels. Preserve clean readable h, no arrow, no house, no cross.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity desktop homepage concept for original Headroom web product, not an implemented screenshot
Reference image role: brand lockup reference only. Preserve the small lowercase headroom wordmark and geometric h with detached lintel as brand identity.
Primary request: an exceptionally polished, restrained 1440px wide desktop website design with convincing typographic craft, clear decision-oriented purpose, warm paper #F6F5F0 background, charcoal #202824 ink, forest #173F36 actions, soft sage #E7EEE8 highlights and thin #D7DCD5 rules. Editorial meets precise financial tool. A large expressive old-style serif similar to Instrument Serif ONLY for the hero heading; all UI in a superbly legible sans serif similar to Inter. Make this feel like a carefully art-directed product, not a template SaaS dashboard.
Composition: full flat browser viewport, no laptop mockup, no perspective. Top 80px nav: small logo left, links "How it works" and "What it covers", quiet outlined "Open your plan" right. Thin bottom rule.
Hero in spacious asymmetric two-column layout: 52% left and 40% right. Left small uppercase eyebrow "FOR SELF-EMPLOYED HOUSEHOLDS"; very large three-line serif headline EXACTLY "Know what your next contract leaves at home." One sans-serif sentence below EXACTLY "Compare taxes, health-insurance credits, and payment timing before you agree." 
Below hero text, a wide white inset input area with thin rule and subtle 12px corners, short label "Start with a client offer", placeholder "Paste the offer or describe the project…", dark forest primary button "Check my offer" and text link "Try the example". Beneath small alternative entry links "Add documents" and "Enter figures"; small text "No account required."
Right a beautiful understated preview sheet, very slight shadow only. Top small "SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE" and "December design project". Bold sans text "One project. Three workable choices." Three horizontal clean comparison rows, no graphs: "Simplest" then "+$8,268"; "More cash overall" then "+$9,695" selected with soft sage fill and a small thin-lined tick; "More into retirement" then "+$9,284". Beneath clear small label "Extra cash after both tax-year settlements" and "Compared with declining the terms". Do not label these figures as cash available now. Quiet rule and bottom link "See the terms and timing →".
Below the hero, a horizontal three-step strip with small numbers, short headings "Bring the offer" / "Review the facts" / "Choose workable terms". No additional paragraphs. Bottom tiny but readable label "DESIGN CONCEPT · ILLUSTRATIVE LAYOUT".
Constraints: large usable typography, strong contrast, generous rhythm and margins, consistent 8px spacing, absolutely no card grid, no generic trend chart, no floating glowing orb, no coins, no stock people, no invented social proof, no fake testimonials, no neon, no decorative gradients, no app download button. Only the exact specified concise text; avoid made-up filler.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity desktop document-review screen concept for Headroom, planned workflow, not current product screenshot
Input image role: style reference for the brand, colors, spacing, optical quality. Preserve small h-with-lintel logo. Do not copy the homepage content.
Create a beautiful calm 1440-wide flat application screenshot, no physical device mockup. Warm paper #F6F5F0, charcoal ink #202824, forest #173F36 buttons, white evidence surface, sage #E7EEE8 selected accents, restrained amber #FFF0D2 only for a question. Inter-like sans-serif for all app text. App title 36px medium, readable body and metadata, no overly thin text.
Small top bar: headroom logo left, "Your household" and "Your plan" center, "Saved in this browser" right with subtle check. Under bar a thin three-step progress line "1  Add information" (complete), "2  Review facts" (active), "3  Compare terms".
Main title EXACTLY "Review what we found." Supporting text EXACTLY "Nothing changes until you confirm."
Two-column workspace: left 39% width source document preview; right 57% confirmed-facts editor.
Left white source sheet with thin border, header "Client offer · synthetic", small "Text excerpt". Document text EXACTLY:
"December design project"
"Total fee: $14,000"
"First payment: $5,925 on Nov 14, 2026"
"Final payment: $8,075 on Jan 4, 2027"
Gently highlight the first-payment line in pale amber. Below source sheet text link "View source". This is a deliberately synthetic brief, not a real invoice.
Right a clean ruled list, no collection of cards. Header "3 terms to review". Three equal rows, each with a small empty confirmation indicator and a subtle source-link icon: "Total price" right "$14,000"; "First payment" right "$5,925 · Nov 14, 2026"; "Final payment" right "$8,075 · Jan 4, 2027". Small muted "Client offer" under each row label.
Below, a single pale amber question region with small label "PAYMENT STATUS", bold question "Has the $5,925 payment arrived?", short reason "An offer does not confirm money received." Three generously spaced radio options: "Not yet" selected, "Already received", "I don't know". Keep radiobuttons clear and simple.
At bottom right a full-width or wide forest button "Confirm terms and continue", secondary "Edit manually". Underneath readable small note "Next: the household facts needed for this offer".
Bottom-left caption "DESIGN CONCEPT · SYNTHETIC DOCUMENT · PLANNED WORKFLOW".
Avoid fake AI confidence percentages, spinning AI orbs, padlock badges with unverified promises, bank logos, upload hallucination progress, financial-result numbers, tax advice, stock photos, tiny unreadable filler. Complete coherent English, real-world usability, disciplined baseline alignment.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity desktop comparison screen design concept for Headroom; synthetic verified example amounts, not implemented screenshot
Input image role: visual design system reference only. Keep Headroom small h-lintel logo, warm paper #F6F5F0, dark ink #202824, forest #173F36, sage #E7EEE8, Inter-like sans serif for all app UI, generous clear spacing, refined thin rules. No new visual style.
Primary request: a beautifully composed flat desktop application screenshot with unusually good financial information hierarchy. All content comfortably readable, not a dense SaaS dashboard.
Top bar: headroom logo left; tabs "Your household" and "Your plan"; right "Synthetic example". Main header "Choose terms that work." Under it "December design project".
Top half: a single wide decision sheet with a vertical divider creating 60% outcome and 40% payment terms. White paper and subtle border, only 12px rounding.
Left outcome area:
small heading "MORE CASH OVERALL"
very large strong tabular figure "+$9,695"
label EXACTLY "Extra cash after 2026 + 2027 tax settlements"
smaller EXACTLY "Compared with declining these terms."
smaller EXACTLY "Final settlement occurs in 2028."
link "Show the calculation"
Right terms area:
small amber outlined label "PROPOSED · CLIENT AGREEMENT NEEDED"
heading "Ask for $14,000"
subheading "Expected payments"
two clear timeline entries with hollow circles:
"Nov 14, 2026" then "$5,925"
"Jan 4, 2027" then "$8,075"
small note "Scheduled receipts, not money received."
Below decision sheet a very clean THREE-ROW comparison table with column headings "Option", "Extra cash after both settlements", "Added retirement". Row 1 "Simplest" / "+$8,268" / "$33". Row 2 selected with pale sage fill and a small radio indicator "More cash overall" / "+$9,695" / "$0". Row 3 "More into retirement" / "+$9,284" / "$500". Make the amounts right-aligned and the labels legible. Below table exact small text "Retirement contributions are separate from spendable cash."
Bottom action row aligned to right: subtle text link "Adjust my goal", forest filled primary "Prepare client draft →". Beneath "Nothing is sent automatically."
Bottom-left caption "DESIGN CONCEPT · SYNTHETIC DATA".
Do not invent a bank balance, cash-by-date amount, savings claim, accepted status, confidence score, artificial graph, client logo or customer endorsement. The $9,695 is a modeled project cash delta versus declining, not savings from Headroom and not available cash today. Convey the difference through accurate labels and layout. Only the exact short English strings above. No serif in the app screen, no paragraphs of filler, no decorative shadows or perspective.

Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high fidelity MOBILE responsive comparison design concept for Headroom, 390 CSS pixel width
Input image role: desktop comparison to responsively reinterpret, preserve exact brand, amounts, colors, and meaning. This is a NEW portrait mobile layout, not a scaled screenshot.
Primary request: one tall flat mobile browser-page design, no phone hardware or desktop surround. Portrait aspect approximately 9:19.5. Warm paper #F6F5F0, forest #173F36, dark ink, white outcome sheet, pale sage selection, pale amber status, crisp Inter-like text. All text and touch targets comfortably large at a real 390px viewport. Horizontal padding 20px, minimum 44px controls. Reduce content by disclosure, never shrink font.
Top bar small headroom h-lintel logo + wordmark left, simple menu icon right.
Small "Synthetic example" line, then bold heading "Choose your terms." and smaller "December design project".
Segmented view selector: "After settlements" selected, "By a date" inactive.
Outcome block:
large "+$9,695"
"Extra cash after 2026 + 2027 tax settlements"
"Compared with declining these terms."
"Final settlement occurs in 2028."
underlined "Show the calculation".
Next separated section with amber outlined tag "CLIENT AGREEMENT NEEDED"
bold "Ask for $14,000"
two strong timeline rows with hollow circles, date on left and money on right:
"Nov 14, 2026" "$5,925"
"Jan 4, 2027" "$8,075"
small "Expected payments · not yet received"
Next section title "Compare the choices"
three ruled radio rows with title at left and amount right:
"Simplest" "+$8,268"
"More cash overall" "+$9,695" selected in sage
"More into retirement" "+$9,284"
one line below "Cash after both settlements" and a tappable disclosure "Retirement and details⌄".
Bottom a clearly separated full-width forest primary button "Prepare client draft →"; text below "Nothing is sent automatically."
At very bottom small readable caption "DESIGN CONCEPT · SYNTHETIC DATA".
Constraints: all figures exact, do not invent cash-now numbers. Do not imply the client agreed. Preserve spacious usable layout and show all requested text by making the canvas taller. No horizontal scroll, no tiny 3-column table, no bank balance, no chart, no fake graph, no glossy phone, no social-proof, no lorem ipsum.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: correct a financial product UI concept without changing its visual direction
Input image is an EDIT TARGET: the Headroom fact-review desktop concept.
Primary request: make exactly these truth-preserving changes in the PAYMENT STATUS area and its main action, preserving all other layout, fonts, colors, headings, source document, amounts, dates, navigation, labels and concept footer.
1. In the amber PAYMENT STATUS panel, ALL THREE radio options must be UNSELECTED: "Not yet", "Already received", "I don't know". Remove the sage fill behind "Not yet" and remove its inner selected radio dot. All three have identical neutral empty outlined circles and plain panel background. Do not infer a payment status.
2. Add a short clearly legible instruction directly below the question or above the three options: "Choose a payment status".
3. The "Confirm terms and continue" button must be unmistakably DISABLED: pale neutral gray fill, muted dark gray text, no saturated forest fill, no fake checkmark. Keep the exact button label. Add small readable helper text immediately below it: "Choose a payment status to continue."
4. Keep the three fact row checkboxes empty because this is pending review. Keep "Edit manually" enabled.
Everything else must stay the same. This remains a DESIGN CONCEPT with a SYNTHETIC DOCUMENT and PLANNED WORKFLOW, not proof of working software. Precise clean English; no new claims.
